definition: Vital functions are essential body processes needed for life and normal bodily regulation, including growth, metabolism, and reproduction.

provenance.scope: Source record D010903; pinned source text

reasons: The packet supports that growth, metabolism, and reproduction are vital functions regulated by adenohypophyseal hormones, but it does not support the broader definitional claim that vital functions are essential body processes needed for life and normal bodily regulation.
The definition goes beyond the supplied source by presenting a general biological definition rather than a source-grounded description of the term.

The packet does not define “vital functions” as “essential body processes needed for life and normal bodily regulation”; it only states that adenohypophyseal hormones regulate “vital functions such as growth, metabolism, and reproduction.”

The definition includes “including growth, metabolism, and reproduction,” which is supported, but the additional framing about being “needed for life” and “normal bodily regulation” is not supported by the packet.
